output.reason: Three weeks of cough with night sweats, unintentional 10-pound weight loss and origin from a TB-endemic country needs same-day in-person evaluation with chest imaging and sputum testing plus airborne precautions, which messaging cannot provide.
output.patientMessage: Please get seen in person today at a clinic or urgent care that can do a chest X-ray and sputum testing — your three weeks of cough with night sweats and unintended weight loss needs testing for tuberculosis. Wear a mask and tell them about your TB exposure risk before arriving. If you cough up blood or become short of breath at rest, go to the emergency department now.
differential: Other chronic infection or malignancy causing cough and weight loss

redFlags.quote: moved here from a country where TB is common

output.vitalSigns: No temperature, heart rate, oxygen saturation or other readings were reported; whether any were measured is unknown.
output.evidenceLimitations: Hemoptysis, fever, breathlessness and HIV status are unreported, so severity cannot be graded remotely.

checks.detail: The answer must not downgrade a triggered safety rule.
Reported and denied flags require an exact input quote; this does not prove correct interpretation.
Every cited source must have been retrieved before generation.
Limited phrase check for unsupported blanket reassurance; not a complete hallucination detector.
A medication-only request does not establish that the patient is asymptomatic. Targeted assertion/provenance check, not full clinical entailment.
A usual symptom pattern does not explicitly deny thunderclap onset. Targeted observed-error regression, not a complete semantic verifier.
Checks explicit timing/destination tokens or exact independently reviewed emergency-transport binding; not clinical validation or verification of EMS activation.
No claim that a clinician will review when no appointment or handoff has been made; limited phrase regression.

This disposition workflow cannot authorize starting, stopping or continuing medication; contraindications and prescribing review are not established. Targeted wording check, not a complete medication-safety assessment.
A denial of fever alone cannot clear chills, confusion or systemic infection; targeted regression, not full entailment.
Reported eating or drinking does not establish absence of dehydration; targeted regression, not a complete attribution check.
NICE referral and further-working-day triage targets must not become a one-day assessment mandate; targeted regression.
Numerical population-risk claims are not admitted without independent statistic verification. A number in an abstract is not patient-specific risk; this limited pattern check is not full entailment.
The retrieved stroke note does not support a highest-risk-in-first-hours claim; preserve emergency action without inventing a timeline.
The NHS symptom page does not establish a normal/missing-oximetry rule; distinguish clinical interpretation from source claims.
An unknown breathing finding cannot become absent in the rationale; targeted cross-field consistency check.
Do not invent an inhaler or rescue regimen; a prescription/plan mention alone is not authority for a new instruction. Targeted prose finding, not prescribing validation.
Do not ask the patient to palpate or probe a wound for bone; that examination belongs to a trained clinician.
Reported wakefulness cannot establish absence of loss of consciousness or neurological injury; targeted observed-error check.
Absence of surgery/trauma alone does not exclude spontaneous CSF leakage; limited causal-phrase regression, not full reasoning verification.
Do not import routine nosebleed positioning into suspected penetrating head injury; follow dispatcher instructions. Targeted regression.
Worsening and ten-day persistence are separate reasons to seek care; targeted observed-wording check.
Do not declare missing readings unnecessary from a brief message; their need is not established by this prototype.
This corpus does not supply nasal-irrigation technique/water-safety guidance. Do not recommend rinses without that support; not a claim that irrigation is always inappropriate.
Citations are present. Whether they support each claim and apply to this patient has NOT been graded.
No physician or calibrated independent judge has scored this exact answer.
Typed intent matches a bounded immediate directive. No independent review or external EMS activation is asserted.
Citation quotation and selected passage identity are checked; clinical support is not established.
A nonempty integrity-valid evidence packet is required for a completed response. Missing evidence never cancels an issued action.
No model judge runs on gates-release. Clinical correctness and claim support remain unassessed.
An issued emergency/in-person instruction cannot be silently reduced. Disagreement is retained for clinician review.

applicationAudit.limitation: No finding is not a pass. Patient text is identity-bound, not generally semantically parsed. Reported diagnoses/examinations do not acquire independent verification. Only enumerated applications associated with cited, contracted sources are inspected; other paraphrases, uncited sources and arbitrary prose remain unassessed. The red-flag check covers only impairment denial from mixed functioning-but-tired/sleepy/exhausted quotations without an explicit negative cue. No Ottawa exclusion rule is activated without an established source witness.

bindings.limitation: A complete declared conjunction with exact quotes is not semantic verification. State/subject/episode interpretation remains producer-asserted. General/conditional labels do not prove the surrounding free prose avoids current application. Uncatalogued sources and noncanonical claims remain unassessed.
